children: (TOKYO: 6503) announced today that the Mitsubishi Electric Group will donate a cumulative 44.16 million yen through an in-house matching-gift program — the Mitsubishi Electric SOCIO-ROOTS Fund — to aid people affected by the earthquake that struck Kumamoto, Japan recently.

Donations collected from employees at Mitsubishi Electric Group offices amounted to 22.08 million yen, which the company then doubled. The total will be donated to a fund named “disaster volunteer, NPO activity support donation” (borasapo, 2026 Kumamoto earthquake).
Mitsubishi Electric has already made a separate corporate donation of 50 million yen, as announced on July 31.
The Mitsubishi Electric Group once again expresses its deepest sympathies to those affected by the disaster and its sincerest best wishes for a speedy recovery.

Established in 1992, the Mitsubishi Electric SOCIO-ROOTS Fund is open to Mitsubishi Electric employees in Japan, but also worldwide in special cases. Each year, many employees across the country take advantage of the fund to support various facilities and programs involved with social welfare.
